status: CAD and calculation only; nothing built.  Stages from the model (machine_family scene, head table in mvp.py, kits.json)
order_note: stages 1-4 and 6 are independent of the latch; stage 5 is held until W1 and W2 are solved on paper and rig-tested

stages.name: MVP: one carriage, one fixed eight-channel pipette, passive deck

parts: CBR-L_coupling_bracket (with the latch channel, unchanged) x 1
PB-F_pusher_bracket (U standoff for the LGA35) x 1
MCL-K_clamp_fork (MVP clamp, replaces the LTG-1 latch until stage 5) x 1
MGN15H_block (4 X + 2 per Z axis) x 6
magnet_N52_D4x2 (tool-plate ID magnets, fitted as on every tool plate) x 4
sealed switch: cradle FORCE switch on the push-rod x 1
D2F switch: pusher CONTACT switch (pad on the slider) x 1
sealed switch: pusher RETRACTED switch x 1
eight-channel 30-300 uL pipette (bought, plunger driven by the pusher) x 1

sub_assemblies: gantry, beam, X and Y drives, chains
carriage A + MCL-1 clamp + M300 tool
passive places: tip frame G3, reservoir F2, plates B2/B4, tip waste B1

stages.demonstrates: XYZ motion, homing and the e-stop/door chain; force-ended pick-up of eight p300 tips; aspirate/dispense with the pusher; reservoir-to-plate and plate-to-plate transfers; a serial dilution across a plate; eject at the tip waste; repeated cycles
stages.test_before_next_stage: T0 (mvp_notes.txt): gravimetric transfer of 8 x 100 uL and 8 x 30 uL to a plate weighed on a lab balance, 10 repeats: per-channel mean within 2 % and CV within 1.5 % at 100 uL (ISO 8655 class targets, ASSUMED for this machine); a 1:2 serial dilution of dye over 11 columns read by absorbance, slope within 5 % of the ideal; 200 pick-up/eject cycles with no missed or retained tip; 20 re-clamps of the tool with nozzle position repeat <= 0.10 mm
stages.carried_over: everything (starter parts unchanged; MCL-1 kept on carriage A until stage 5)

stages.name: second carriage B with a fixed single-channel 0.5-10 uL pipette

sealed switch: cradle FORCE switch on the push-rod x 1
D2F switch: pusher CONTACT switch (pad on the slider) x 1
sealed switch: pusher RETRACTED switch x 1

adds.deck: p10 tip frame at G1 (starter place), small-tube rack ATR-3 at A2 (passive, plain insert already fitted)
sub_assemblies: carriage B Z axis + pusher + MCL-1 clamp

stages.demonstrates: two carriages without collision (firmware keep-out), single-channel tube work, 8-channel and single-channel in one run
stages.test_before_next_stage: both carriages run the T0 programme interleaved for 4 h with no collision guard trip; S10 gravimetric at 1, 5, 10 uL
cad_files: cad/lh1/head_l/build.py (carriage B is the same axis at x 0)
